title: NTFS resource and security-descriptor observation (v1)
description: A directory together with descriptor-level facts. The ACE list alone is ambiguous: a NULL DACL (dacl_present=false) grants everyone full access, while a present-but-empty DACL grants nobody access. Those opposite meanings collapse into the same empty list unless dacl_present is reported. A resource is identified by its canonical UNC path; a local path alone is ambiguous because the server is unknown.

dacl_present.description: false means a NULL DACL: everyone has full access. Always a finding.

dacl_protected.description: SE_DACL_PROTECTED: the object blocks inheritance from its parent.

ace_count.description: Number of ACEs in the DACL. Must be 0 when dacl_present is false, and must match the number of ntfs_ace observations reported for this path in the same run.

is_acl_boundary.description: The DACL differs from the parent's. A resource that blocks inheritance is by definition a boundary.

acl_hash.description: Digest of the normalized DACL this resource carried when it was read, computed by the collector from the whole descriptor it had in hand. Optional and additive (contract 1.2). The server stores it as reported and independently recomputes the same digest from the ntfs_ace observations it holds; the two are reported separately so a disagreement is visible rather than resolved by fiat.
